run_CLIPGuidedStableDiffusion_pipeline: run the CLIPGuidedStableDiffusion pipeline to generate images guided by CLIP text embeddings
create_CLIPGuidedStableDiffusion_instanc: create a CLIPGuidedStableDiffusion pipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, clip_model, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, and feature_extractor
run_cond_fn_clip_guidance: run the cond_fn method to compute CLIP guidance gradients and adjust noise predictions during diffusion
run_MakeCutouts_augmentation: run MakeCutouts to generate randomized spatial cutouts of image tensors for CLIP feature matching
run_spherical_dist_loss: run spherical_dist_loss to compute spherical distance between normalized CLIP embedding vectors
